events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Amid Risk-On Mood
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as Asian stock markets traded higher, as traders react positively to the Democrats' decisive victory in the midterm elections after they won control of both the House and Senate, with crude oil prices plummeting on hopes of a potential end to the Middle East conflict.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As AI-data Center Stocks Slide On Regulation Worries
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Thursday as regional chipmaking shares slumped on expectations of tighter tech oversight.

events.title: Indonesia GDP Growth Tops Expectations
events.description: Indonesia's economic growth accelerated in the third quarter driven by strong increases in government spending and investment, official data showed Thursday. Gross domestic product grew 5.47 percent year-on-year in the third quarter, Statistics Indonesia said.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Mostly Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Thursday, even as technology stocks may come under selling pressure on concerns that a Democratic-led U.S. Congress could push for tighter regulation of AI development and data center construction, which could lead to a slowdown in capex.

events.title: Indian Shares Surge As Oil Prices Slump
events.description: Indian shares opened on a buoyant note on Thursday, extending gains for a sixth consecutive session as global bond yields eased and Brent crude prices plummeted to $94 a barrel on hopes that the U.S.-Iran war could end soon.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is extending its early gains in mid-market moves on Thursday, reversing the losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is surging 2 percent to above the 9,000 mark, with strong gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Higher
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly higher on Thursday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, as traders react positively to the Democrats' decisive victory in the midterm elections after they won control of both the House and Senate, with crude oil prices plummeting on hopes of a potential end to the Middle East conflict. Asian markets closed mixed on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Set To Extend Gains On Firm Global Cues
events.description: Indian shares look set to extend recent gains on Thursday, with underlying sentiment likely to be underpinned by renewed foreign fund inflows and a sharp retreat in international crude oil prices.

events.title: Thai Stock Market Tipped To Open In The Green
events.description: The Thai stock market on Wednesday ended the six-day losing streak in which it had tumbled more than 85 points or 5.5 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,500-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading notably higher on Thursday, reversing some of the losses in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 62,450 level, with gains in automakers, retailers and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in technology stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had dropped more than 225 points or 4 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 4,920-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Win Streak May Continue For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in four straight sessions, collecting more than 950 points or 4.2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,920-point plateau and it may add to its winnings again on Thursday.
